qualification_limits: Runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION throughout. No source category implies runtime pass/fail, counts/ledger promotion, deletion/retirement authorization or completion.

Seven parent-package roots are conservatively unresolved due to shared Config{Lab:true} referencing a removed field; no replacement fixture or successor source inferred. Intended paths are documented but uncredited.

Valid separate subpackage Store fixture directly starts upstream NATS server.NewServer with authorization token and nats.Connect over loopback TCP; real JetStream file-backed KV has one replica. This does not establish quorum, failover, production JWT/TLS or regional clustering.

Blocked parent integrationStore names natscell.Start, whose pinned production implementation would use in-process NATS clients after production TLS/JWT validation. That path is not reached by the incompatible fixture and receives no boundary credit.

OCI fixtures use actual upstream SDK HTTP to httptest.NewServer URLs with synthetic state. Shared handler checks only nonempty Authorization; it does not independently verify RSA signature or real OCI IAM, instance principal, live resources or packet-filter semantics. No environment or runtime containment proof is claimed.

NSG provider methods are in-memory simulations only behind actual HTTP dispatch; handler request observations, conditional ETags, read hooks and real desired/operation CAS support only cited source assertions.

Lost-response fixtures commit in-memory conditional replacement then hijack/close actual HTTP connection. Reconstructed Controller reuses same live KV and SDK fixtures; no process/broker restart, service persistence across restart or live provider durability is proved.

Route/security-list tombstones relinquish management locally before OCI Get and use real KV purge; they never delete the OCI table/list or strip its routes/rules. Tombstone source classification authorizes no retirement.

Independent error-only invalid-spec blocks in NSG batching and route validation, plus empty-ETag SDK UpdateTable, remain unit-only within mixed roots. NSG persistent validation instead pairs each invalid rejection with actual store emptiness and accepted maximum-size readback.

Runner authority and cloud adapters are fake. Wake ticks are sent even on reconcile error and no storage result is checked; no runner integration credit is inferred from background calls. Source blocker further prevents root qualification.

No repo/source/ledger mutations, build/test/Go/helper/scanner/parser/framework execution, process/resource probes, downloads, locks, privilege/cloud/signing/crypto/TerraBase execution. All safety obligations retained.
